cohort: 97 patients with FET conception and 477 patients with natural conception (NC) who underwent labor and delivery at a single clinic between December 2015 and June 2019
finding: Frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) resulted in larger offspring than natural conception (NC) throughout pregnancy, with accelerated growth observed only during the first trimester.
birth_weight: Birthweight was adjusted for sex, parity, and gestational age
